name: The Lost Lantern
description: Help the village recover its magical lantern to lift the night fog.

stages.narrative: Talk to the villagers and search the town square for clues.

objectives.description: Speak with Elder Heron near the fountain.
Inspect three clues scattered around the square.

stages.narrative: Enter the forest glade and reclaim the lantern from the goblin camp.

objectives.description: Defeat the goblin guard who stole the lantern.
Pick up the enchanted lantern from the altar.
